question: What selected functional source routes and typed operands support future profiles for the16 fixed ground vehicle families?
inference: Labels describe serialized source alternatives; they do not establish default loadouts.
Health/mobility field meanings remain unresolved. Hotfix ammo-struct word names are candidate-only from the release control.
unresolved: Current stage is partial. Two base roots and two functional variants were not captured in the DB used by this stage. Parent has since captured these at run-root capture-missing-roots-winps/raw; inspection belongs to the next stage.
Conservative profile budget exhausted at400 unique reads. 50 labelled selected weapon-owner alternatives and34 entry-owner instances are source facts, not defaults or usable-seat counts.
56 entity configuration f32 words are hash-only; no named health, speed, acceleration, damage-zone or repair formula is claimed.

Sixteen of20 unique selected WB owners have typed Struct_598cc52c.Field_7f22bfb4 i32 checks. Release MagazineCapacity naming is candidate-only across Head/descriptor; other WB ammo/cadence/projectile operands are not checked in this stage.
34 selected entry input imports need three exact same-build targets: InputConcepts_Car, InputConcepts_Tank, InputConcepts_VehicleGunner. Exact routes/GUIDs are in missing-selected-targets-v2.json.
Fresh shared-health source and L3001 v3 exact GRX child/owner method are next-stage inputs; generic semantic limits are not an absence conclusion.
Cosmetic assets were not inspected and no role was positively excluded by naming alone. CWS/CROWS is outside this fixed ground-family scope.
siteImpact: Future source-backed ground-vehicle comparison proposal only. No current weapon/attachment site change. Retain functional alternatives and source availability limits.
